Sends HTTP Basic authentication header

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { WasmAuthConfig, WasmCrawlConfig, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg-wasm";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = WasmCrawlConfig.default();
  engineConfig.auth = { password: "testpass", type: "basic", username: "testuser" } as WasmAuthConfig;
  engineConfig.respectRobotsTxt = false;
  engineConfig.ssrf.denyPrivate = false;
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.authHeaderSent);
  console.log(result.statusCode);
}

void main();
```
